hero.s: Behavioural insights for B2B: we study how buying committees decide, then remove what stalls deals.

insights.title: Nobody gets fired for safe
insights.text: Committees choose what they can defend. Proof of safety beats proof of power.

insights.title: Too many plans, no plan
insights.text: Crowded tiers and feature lists stall the room. One clear default moves it.

insights.title: Switching feels like losing
insights.text: Migration risk looms larger than new gains. Make the move feel small and reversible.

insights.title: The status quo is the rival
insights.text: Teams stick with what they know. Your real competitor is doing nothing.

faq.question: How long does a behavioural insight engagement take for B2B?
faq.answer: An insight sprint runs 4 to 6 weeks. Design and demand work follow in phases, each aimed at one behaviour in the buying process.

faq.question: Do you work with long B2B sales cycles?
faq.answer: Yes. We map every stakeholder in the buying committee and test messages for each role, so the work fits how deals are really decided.

faq.question: How do you measure impact in B2B?
faq.answer: Against one agreed behaviour per phase, such as a demo booked or a trial activated. The baseline is agreed before work starts.

faq.question: Is buyer data kept safe?
faq.answer: We sign an NDA before any data is shared and work within your security and privacy policies.

cta.p: A 15-minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your buyers hesitate.
